headline: Kuura Strand Erupts as Nevish Line Battle Rages On
war_summary: Since the midday edition Kuura Strand has surged from quiet to the fastest wire, posting 10 changes in two hours and 24 on the day to stand five Warden-held with one unheld around Suosalo, Faden Point and Talven at the hour of filing, with 24-hour losses near 1,292 Colonial and 1,083 Warden. The Nevish Line remains the heaviest sustained fight with 7 changes in two hours and 46 on the day, now three Warden to five Colonial around Grief Mother, Blackcoat Way and Princefal, with day losses near 6,164 Colonial and 6,766 Warden and both hourly rates still accelerating. Callahan's Passage and Palantine Berm have gone quiet in the last two hours after busy days of 29 and 36 changes to stand eight Warden to two Colonial and seven Warden-held respectively, last heard at 11:35. The Weathered Expanse counts three changes in two hours and 27 on the day at two Warden to seven Colonial around Shattered Advance, while Stlican Shelf has cooled to none in two hours with 15 on the day and Viper Pit shows fresh movement with two changes at Blackthroat.
